Class CharacterCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.model.card.CharacterCard
public class CharacterCard extends Object
Represents an immutable character card. Each card belongs to a specific Era, has a CharacterType, and carries a CharacterEffect that is applied immediately when the card is drawn.

    • CharacterCard

      public CharacterCard(String cardID, Era era, CharacterType type, int minPlayers, CharacterEffect characterEffect)
      Parameters:
      cardID - unique identifier for this card (e.g. "C_001")
      era - the game era this card belongs to
      type - the character archetype (HUNTER, BUILDER, etc.)
      minPlayers - minimum number of players required for this card to be included in the deck
      characterEffect - the effect applied when this card enters a tribe
